title: Implement append-only audit event journal
purpose: Make every intention, decision, prepared effect, observed result, commit, and rollback traceable across crashes.
scope: Define event types: IntentReceived, PlanFrozen, ApprovalBound, EffectPrepared, EffectObserved, CommitSealed, RollbackPending, RollbackObserved, RecoveryStarted, RecoveryCompleted.
Persist events in append-only JSONL or SQLite/WAL-backed event store.
Add event integrity fields: run_id, step_id, actor, timestamp, policy_version, tool_version, parameter_hash, parent_event.
Provide query API for latest run, run timeline, and unresolved effects.
acceptance_criteria: EffectPrepared is written before any side-effecting executor is invoked.
CommitSealed only appears after verification succeeds.
Unsealed effects can be listed after process restart.
Audit records do not include secret plaintext.
verification: Simulate a process restart after EffectPrepared and verify unresolved state is discoverable.
Run log redaction tests for secret-like input.
risk_notes: A plan log is not enough; recovery must reason over effects that may already have happened.
